angles.title: A morning walk, before it has a point

uses.quote: It was about mornings, I think, or maybe about the walk.

open_questions: What is the walk evidence of — a routine, a mood, a place?
Who would read this, and what should they come away with?

angles.title: Writing about the city

uses.quote: My sister says I should write about the city more, but I don't know which part of the city.

open_questions: Which part of the city, and why that part?
